entries.title: Phone Connect
entries.text: Your paired phone: whether it is online, the recorder and the auto-approval rules.

entries.title: Phone Connect settings
entries.text: Pair or revoke the phone, choose which notifications reach it, and set up its floating toolbar and popups.

entries.title: Page
entries.text: Where you set “Page”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Phone Connect.

entries.title: Add a button
entries.text: Adds a button. Part of Phone Connect.

entries.title: Comes in

entries.title: Goes out
entries.text: Where you set “Goes out”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Phone Connect.

entries.title: Stays
entries.text: Slide to set “Stays”: left is less, right is more. Part of Phone Connect.

entries.title: Opacity
entries.text: Slide to set “Opacity”: left is less, right is more. Part of Phone Connect.

entries.title: Sound
entries.text: Turns “Sound” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Phone Connect.

entries.title: Vibrate
entries.text: Turns “Vibrate” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Phone Connect.

entries.title: Button size
entries.text: Slide to set “Button size”: left is less, right is more. Part of Phone Connect.

entries.title: Circle
entries.text: Shows the “Circle” part of this screen. Part of Phone Connect.

entries.title: Collapse after
entries.text: Slide to set “Collapse after”: left is less, right is more. Part of Phone Connect.

entries.title: Toolbar opacity
entries.text: Slide to set “Toolbar opacity”: left is less, right is more. Part of Phone Connect.

entries.title: Monitor

entries.title: Play popup

entries.title: New code

entries.title: Open pages in

entries.title: Phone recorder
entries.text: Opens the Phone recorder screen. Connects Brett's Android phone to the console through the small Phone Connect companion app (phone-connect@1).
